excerpt.zh:
在[From.GetName]进行的环境改造产生了意想不到的后果。我们未曾意识到，该星球表层的土壤是一种含有高浓度易爆微粒的细颗粒混合物，而我们的改造过程扰动了这些微粒，并将其散布到了整个星球的大气中。

不幸的是，这些空气中的高能粒子增加了地表意外燃烧事件的风险。任何未来的殖民地都必须优先考虑事故和冲突的预防，以避免灾难性的后果。

然而，如果我们能够谨慎管控这些危险，[From.GetName]的大气将成为这些稀有材料的丰富来源。
excerpt.en: Terraforming on [From.GetName] had unforeseen consequences. Unbeknown to us, the planet's topsoil was a fine particle mix containing  high concentrations of Volatile Motes which our terraforming process disturbed and seeded throughout the planet's atmosphere.

不幸的是，这些空气中的高能粒子增加了地表意外燃烧事件的风险。任何未来的殖民地都必须优先考虑事故和冲突的预防，以避免灾难性的后果。

然而，如果我们能够谨慎管控这些危险，[From.GetName]的大气将成为这些稀有材料的丰富来源。
texts.en:
Terraforming on [From.GetName] had unforeseen consequences. Unbeknown to us, the planet's topsoil was a fine particle mix containing  high concentrations of Volatile Motes which our terraforming process disturbed and seeded throughout the planet's atmosphere.

Unfortunately, these airborne high-energy particles increase the risk of unintended combustion events on the surface. Any future colony will have to prioritize accident and conflict prevention in order to avoid devastating consequences.

However if we are able to manage the dangers carefully, the atmosphere of [From.GetName] will become a rich source of these rare materials.
